notes.title: Patchnote Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're excited to present to you Patch 1.0.1, which primarily focuses on resolving a few minor bugs to enhance your gaming experience. Here are the details:


Bug Fixes:

 - Fixed an issue where players could encounter sporadic crashes during transitions between certain zones.

 - Resolved a bug that caused incorrect display of certain UI elements on screens with specific resolutions.

 - Fixed a lighting issue in certain particular zones.




We appreciate your patience and continuous support. Please continue to provide us with your feedback to help make the game even better!


The development team
